# CMakeLists.txt — AERIS-10 STM32F746ZGT7 firmware (RECONSTRUCTED, UNVERIFIED)
#
# Status: NOT BUILT. No ARM toolchain or STM32CubeF7 package was available when this file was
# written (2026-10-08). The source list is verified against the repository; compiler flags are
# the usual STM32CubeIDE defaults for an F746 (ASSUMED). Four files must be generated by
# STM32CubeMX (see docs/STM32/STM32_PROJECT_RECONSTRUCTION.md, STM-T02) and placed in ./cube/:
#   cube/startup_stm32f746zgtx.s  cube/STM32F746ZGTX_FLASH.ld
#   cube/USB_DEVICE/App/{usb_device.c,usbd_cdc_if.c,usbd_desc.c}  cube/USB_DEVICE/Target/usbd_conf.c
# Invoke:
#   cmake -S . -B ../../../build/stm32 -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=arm-none-eabi.cmake -DCUBE_F7=/path/to/STM32CubeF7
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(aeris10_stm32 C CXX ASM)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
if(NOT DEFINED CUBE_F7)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set -DCUBE_F7=<STM32CubeF7 root> (run tools/stm32_check_cube_package.sh first)")
endif()
set(LIB  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../9_1_1_C_Cpp_Libraries)
set(CODE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../9_1_3_C_Cpp_Code)
set(CUBE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cube)
set(HAL  ${CUBE_F7}/Drivers/STM32F7xx_HAL_Driver)
set(CMSIS ${CUBE_F7}/Drivers/CMSIS)
set(USB  ${CUBE_F7}/Middlewares/ST/STM32_USB_Device_Library)

# ASSUMED flags (STM32CubeIDE defaults for STM32F746 with single-precision FPU)
set(MCU_FLAGS -mcpu=cortex-m7 -mthumb -mfpu=fpv5-sp-d16 -mfloat-abi=hard)
add_compile_options(${MCU_FLAGS} -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Wall -Og -g3)
add_compile_definitions(STM32F746xx USE_HAL_DRIVER)
add_link_options(${MCU_FLAGS} -T${CUBE}/STM32F746ZGTX_FLASH.ld --specs=nano.specs --specs=nosys.specs
                 -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,-Map=${PROJECT_NAME}.map)

# Application sources (verified present). Excluded on purpose: platform_noos_stm32.c (undefined
# hal_set_gpio_by_index), iio.c/iio_app.c/iiod.c (networking headers), adar1000.c (unused C driver),
# no_os_* files not referenced by main.cpp are listed only where main.cpp/adf4382/ad9523 need them.
set(APP_SRC
  ${CODE}/main.cpp
  ${LIB}/USBHandler.cpp ${LIB}/RadarSettings.cpp ${LIB}/ADAR1000_Manager.cpp
  ${LIB}/gps_handler.cpp ${LIB}/TinyGPS++.cpp ${LIB}/BMP180.cpp
  ${LIB}/GY_85_HAL.c ${LIB}/ADS7830.c ${LIB}/DA5578.c
  ${LIB}/ad9523.c ${LIB}/adf4382.c ${LIB}/adf4382a_manager.c
  ${LIB}/stm32_spi.c ${LIB}/stm32_delay.c
  ${LIB}/no_os_spi.c ${LIB}/no_os_util.c ${LIB}/no_os_alloc.c ${LIB}/no_os_gpio.c ${LIB}/no_os_mutex.c
  ${LIB}/stm32f7xx_hal_msp.c ${LIB}/stm32f7xx_it.c ${LIB}/system_stm32f7xx.c ${LIB}/syscalls.c ${LIB}/sysmem.c
)
set(CUBE_SRC
  ${CUBE}/startup_stm32f746zgtx.s
  ${CUBE}/USB_DEVICE/App/usb_device.c ${CUBE}/USB_DEVICE/App/usbd_cdc_if.c ${CUBE}/USB_DEVICE/App/usbd_desc.c
  ${CUBE}/USB_DEVICE/Target/usbd_conf.c
)
file(GLOB HAL_SRC
  ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal.c ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_cortex.c ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_rcc.c ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_rcc_ex.c
  ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_gpio.c ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_dma.c ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_dma_ex.c ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_exti.c
  ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_flash.c ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_flash_ex.c ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_pwr.c ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_pwr_ex.c
  ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_i2c.c ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_i2c_ex.c ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_spi.c ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_spi_ex.c
  ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_tim.c ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_tim_ex.c ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_uart.c ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_uart_ex.c
  ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_pcd.c ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_hal_pcd_ex.c ${HAL}/Src/stm32f7xx_ll_usb.c
  ${USB}/Core/Src/usbd_core.c ${USB}/Core/Src/usbd_ctlreq.c ${USB}/Core/Src/usbd_ioreq.c ${USB}/Class/CDC/Src/usbd_cdc.c
)
add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME}.elf ${APP_SRC} ${CUBE_SRC} ${HAL_SRC})
# NOTE: ${LIB} is placed LAST so that the toolchain <errno.h> wins over LIB/errno.h (#include_next hazard).
target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME}.elf PRIVATE
  ${CODE} ${CUBE}/USB_DEVICE/App ${CUBE}/USB_DEVICE/Target
  ${HAL}/Inc ${CMSIS}/Include ${CMSIS}/Device/ST/STM32F7xx/Include ${USB}/Core/Inc ${USB}/Class/CDC/Inc
  ${LIB})
add_custom_command(TARGET ${PROJECT_NAME}.elf POST_BUILD
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_SIZE} ${PROJECT_NAME}.elf
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} -O ihex ${PROJECT_NAME}.elf ${PROJECT_NAME}.hex)
